name: if-this-finds-you-promo
description: The launch video for If This Finds You, drawn frame by frame with the site's own engine (../engine) and app code (../app/src) in Remotion. Not part of the site build.

scripts.studio: node scripts/click.mjs && node scripts/node-ts.mjs scripts/sound.ts && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.canvas: node scripts/canvas-hands.mjs 4908 && remotion render src/index.ts Atlas public/atlas --sequence --image-format=png --image-sequence-pattern='page-[frame].[ext]'
scripts.render: node scripts/node-ts.mjs scripts/sound.ts && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/draft-540.mp4 --crf=22
scripts.render:final: node scripts/node-ts.mjs scripts/sound.ts && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo-x-30fps.mp4 --props='{"size":1080}'
scripts.render:60: node scripts/node-ts.mjs scripts/sound.ts && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo-60fps.mp4 --props='{"size":1080,"fps":60}'
scripts.render:timing: node scripts/click.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/timing-540.mp4 --crf=22 --props='{"grid":true,"audio":"click"}'
scripts.specimens: node scripts/node-ts.mjs scripts/specimens.ts 120 && remotion render src/index.ts Specimen out/specimens --sequence --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82 --image-sequence-pattern='hand-[frame].[ext]'
